name: Option Data 2
definition: Set of data which contains the link to a previously notified option trade.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Date at which the trading parties have agreed on an option trade.

NotificationIdentification.name: Notification Identification
NotificationIdentification.definition: Refers to the identification of a trade assigned by the trading side of a foreign exchange option trade.

CommonReference.name: Common Reference
CommonReference.definition: Reference common to the parties of a trade.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Refers to the identification of a previous event in the life of a foreign exchange option trade.

AmendOrCancelReason.name: Amend Or Cancel Reason
AmendOrCancelReason.definition: Describes the reason for the cancellation or the amendment.

Option.name: Option
Option.definition: Set of data defining a foreign exchange option sold.
